+def test_named_text_io_wrapper_does_not_close_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<first>", mode="w"
+    )
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<second>", mode="w"
+    )
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.close()
+    second.write(" second")
+    second.close()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"first second"
+
+
+def test_stream_mixer_finalization_does_not_close_streams():
+    mixer = StreamMixer()
+    stdout = mixer.stdout
+    stderr = mixer.stderr
+    output = mixer.output
+    stdout.write(b"out")
+    stderr.write(b"err")
+
+    del mixer
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == b"out"
+    assert stderr.getvalue() == b"err"
+    assert output.getvalue() == b"outerr"
+
